def: linsey-woolsey, i.e. cloth of linen and wool carded and spun together
kjv: garment of divers sorts, linen and wollen.

occurrences.text: Ye shall keep my statutes. Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind: thou shalt not sow thy field with mingled seed: neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woollen come upon thee.
Thou shalt not wear a garment of divers sorts, as of woollen and linen together.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
